verdict.rationale: Groq is an LLM inference API, so offering embeddings and reranking for retrieval pipelines is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack documents only chat completions, the Responses API, transcription, structured outputs, tool use, batch, and LoRA. No item mentions an embeddings or rerank endpoint, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate embeddings (and rerank results) for retrieval pipelines without a second vendor
